{'Translation': '《金融時報》最新分析顯示，Apple 自 2024 年 6 月以來已與歐盟政策制定者會面 257 次，並每年花費 800 萬至 900 萬歐元於遊說工作。以下是詳細內容。', 'SourceText': 'A new analysis from Financial Times shows that Apple has met with EU policymakers 257 times since June 2024, and spends between €8 million and €9 million per year on lobbying.'}

{'Translation': '在布魯塞爾的主要科技公司遊說者中，Apple 落後於 Google', 'SourceText': 'Apple falls behind Google among major tech lobbyists in Brussels'}

{'SourceText': "A report published today by Financial Times (via MacMagazine) notes that 'Google, Apple and Amazon have had more meetings with European Parliament and European Commission officials than any European company.'"}

{'Translation': '報吿根據歐盟的透明度登記冊，以及歐洲議會和歐盟委員會的會議資料庫數據，指出 Apple 每年在歐盟總部的遊說開支達 900 萬歐元，比 Total、Volkswagen 和 Airbus 三家公司加起來還多。《金融時報》提到，Meta 的年度遊說開支更高，逾 1,000 萬歐元。', 'SourceText': "The report, based on data from the EU's Transparency Register and the meeting databases of the European Parliament and European Commission, notes that Apple spends €9 million per year lobbying in the EU headquarters — more than Total, Volkswagen, and Airbus combined. The FT notes that Meta's annual lobbying spend is even higher, exceeding €10 million."}

{'Translation': '報吿內容如下：', 'SourceText': 'The report states:'}

{'Translation': '《金融時報》蒐集了自 2024 年 6 月——即最近一次歐洲議會選舉舉行之時——以來的會議數據，發現 Apple 在該段期間與歐盟政策制定者會面了 257 次，僅次於 Google 的 302 次，在主要科技公司中排名第二。', 'SourceText': "Gathering meeting data since June 2024 — when the most recent European Parliament elections took place — the FT found that Apple has had 257 meetings with EU policymakers during this period, coming second only to Google's 302 and ranking it second among major tech companies."}

{'Translation': 'Amazon 亦躋身前 20 名，以 239 次會面位列第 14，而世界自然基金會（WWF）則以 431 次位居整體榜首，印證了《金融時報》「綠色非政府組織是最活躍的遊說團體」的分析。', 'SourceText': "Amazon also made it into the top 20, coming in 14th with 239 meetings, while the World Wildlife Fund (WWF) ranked first overall with 431 meetings, corroborating the FT's analysis that 'green NGOs are the most active lobbyists.'"}

{'Translation': '據報導，Apple 和 Amazon 就此回應《金融時報》時表示，「他們就對客戶和業務重要的議題與政策制定者交流。」', 'SourceText': "In response to the FT, Apple and Amazon reportedly said that 'they engage with policymakers on issues that are important to their customers and businesses.'"}

{'Translation': '欲閱讀《金融時報》完整報吿，請按此連結。', 'SourceText': 'To read the full FT report, click this link.'}
